profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: Motivated, responsible and focused senior software developer with 20+ years of experience designing, implementing and adapting technically sophisticated business applications using Oracle Apex 23, Java / J2EE platform, Oracle PL/SQL, C++ and more.  Skilled in translating business requirements into technical solutions, utilizing Application Life Cycle management.  Strong interpersonal, written and oral communication skills.   Experienced with complexities of enterprise grade software development and deployment. Specialties: Java / J2EE platform, Spring, Hibernate, RESTful services, object-oriented analysis / design, UML, Weblogic, Websphere, Intellij, Eclipse, JUnit, JSF, Struts, github, Rational ClearCase, TOAD, DBVisualizer, Bourne / bash / c / korn shell scripting, soapUI, PL/SQL, LDAP, Oracle forms and reports, Oracle and DB2 databases.  Familiar with Sharepoint and Power BI for project visualization and metrics.

positions.title: IT Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Working on software development for in-house fuel supply application that automates rail receipts of a statewide coal delivery system, which monitors the movement and health of rail cars via vendor-supplied tracking data to manage coal inventory, plan production schedules, and plan rail car maintenance, written in custom Oracle Apex.
Worked on software development for in-house customer service and billing application to replace an existing system with 20+ internal and external interfaces, that manages all aspects of a customer's electric & gas service written in custom Java EE.
Worked on the Customer Service Online system, in-house web-based application for customers to enroll in paperless billing and electronic payments of their gas and electric bills.  Also worked on Credit and Collections system to write and support batch and online GUI application, developed and monitored accuracy of automated complex account shutoff criteria, including numerous data interfaces to other systems, such as billing and printing.  Implemented large volume data interface to outside collection agencies ensuring accurate account assignment.

positions.title: Part-time Faculty in CIS Department
positions.description: Taught C++ (Course number CIS260) and MS Office (Course number CIS115).  Successfully worked with large class sizes to meet individual needs of the students.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Worked in the Banking Division on a 10 member development team writing an on-line and batch banking software package, which implemented functionality for account reconciliation, collateral, on-line archiving, payment allocation, payment control, report journaling, bank statement processing and printing, combined account, IRA/Keogh and alternate language statements, list post capability and reversal processing.

positions.title: Contract Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Worked on a 70-member team contracted to Options Clearing Corp., designing an options clearing system to be used by the Chicago Board Options Exchange. 
Wrote detailed specifications for programs, dialogs and database connections.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Worked as applications support and development for G/L, A/P and Payroll packages. Designed and coded custom enhancements to G/L application to meet complex requirements for year-end bookkeeping.

positions.title: Contract Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Developed and implemented a complete batch transaction and reporting system for "Equal Access" long distance service for New York Telephone, along with developing and implementing an on-line billing adjustment system.  Shared responsibility in developing and implementing new health/benefits plans, and 401(k) payroll benefits plan for Equitable Life.
